description: Railways Map of Australia 2014 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. The railways that link urban and regional Australia have played a significant role in the development of our nation. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
